look_fallbacks: ^Eddie squints at it. It doesn't squint back. Small mercies.
use_fallbacks: ^Eddie pokes at it experimentally. Nothing happens. This is why he's a roadie and not an engineer.
pickup_fallbacks: ^Eddie reaches for it, then reconsiders. Some things are better left where they are. Like this thing. And Eddie's career.
talk_fallbacks: ^Eddie opens his mouth to talk to it, then remembers it's an inanimate object. He does this more often than he'd like to admit.
look_speaker: ^A speaker so heavy it probably has its own zip code. There's something underneath it, but moving it would require either a lever or significantly more upper body strength than Eddie possesses.
look_mic_stand: ^A mic stand held together by rust and optimism. It leans slightly to the left, like it's tired. Eddie can relate.
look_bar_counter: ^The bar counter has seen things. Done things. Absorbed things. The layers of stickiness tell a story — a gross, unsanitary story, but a story nonetheless.
look_poster: ^A faded poster for a band called "Temporary Deafness." Their tagline: "You'll thank us when it's over."
^Eddie isn't sure if that's a threat or a promise.
look_jukebox: ^An ancient jukebox that lists two songs: "Heartbreak Hotel" and something called "DO NOT PLAY."
^The "DO NOT PLAY" button has been pressed so many times it's worn smooth.
^Nobody knows what the song is. Nobody who's heard it will talk about it.
look_crate: ^A wooden crate full of cables that have achieved sentience through sheer entanglement. Darwin would be fascinated. Eddie is just annoyed.
look_door: ^A door. It leads somewhere else. Specifically, somewhere that isn't here. That's either its best or worst quality, depending on the day.
look_dumpster: ^A dumpster that doubles as a archaeological dig site for broken dreams and discarded setlists. It smells exactly how you'd expect. Actually, it smells worse.
look_cat: ^A stray cat with the confidence of a headliner and the hygiene of a mosh pit. It watches Eddie with the quiet judgment of someone who's made better life choices.
look_toolbox: ^A toolbox. The last bastion of hope for anyone trying to fix anything in this venue. It's red, which is either a design choice or a warning.
look_crowbar: ^A crowbar. Half-Life fans would be excited. Eddie is just cold.
use_jukebox: ^Eddie feeds it a coin. The jukebox makes a sound like a robot having a mid-life crisis, plays three notes of "Stairway to Heaven," then gives up entirely.
^Fair enough. Even the jukebox knows some songs are too ambitious for this venue.
use_dumpster: ^Eddie rummages through the dumpster. He finds broken dreams, a mysterious substance, and what might be a guitar pick or a very small tortilla chip.
^give_item: guitar_pick, Guitar Pick, A pick salvaged from a dumpster. Has seen things.
use_door: ^Eddie opens the door. On the other side: more venue. It's venues all the way down.
use_mic_stand: ^Eddie grabs the mic stand and poses. For a moment — just a moment — he's a rock star.
^Then gravity and self-awareness kick in. The moment passes.
use_broken_thing: ^It's broken. Eddie's not great at fixing things. He's more of a "carry things and set them down slightly to the left" kind of guy.
^That's literally his job description. He checked.
talk_to_object: ^The object says nothing. Because it's an object.
^Eddie isn't sure what he expected. He IS sure this isn't the weirdest thing he's done today.
talk_to_cat: ^The cat stares at Eddie with the intensity of a thousand disapproving grandmothers.
^Then it licks its paw. Conversation over.
^Eddie has been dismissed. By a cat. In an alley. Behind a bar.
^This is rock bottom. Or at least rock adjacent.
generic_combine_fail: ^Eddie tries to combine the two items. They don't combine. They're not even compatible. Like pineapple on pizza, but for adventure game inventory items.
^Actually, pineapple on pizza at least TASTES like something. This combination tastes like failure.
nothing_happens: ^This is either a zen moment or a bug. Eddie can't tell. Neither can the developer, probably.
already_done: ^Eddie already did that. Once was enough. Twice would be a pattern. Three times would be a hobby.
^Eddie has enough hobbies. Like carrying heavy things and questioning his life choices.
cant_reach: ^Eddie stretches. Strains. Makes a noise that's somewhere between a grunt and a prayer.
^Nope. Can't reach it. His arms are too short, the thing is too far, and the laws of physics remain uncooperative.
inventory_full: ^Eddie's pockets are full. His hands are full. His heart is full — wait, no. That last one's just heartburn from the bar's "food."
^He needs to use or drop something first.
dark_too_dark: ^It's too dark to see anything. Eddie waves his hands around like a mime having a bad day.
^He touches something. He's not sure what. He doesn't want to find out.
